simple.meaning: אָדָם (ʼâdâm) appears 552 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Genesis 1:26. The background comes from the surrounding verses where the name appears.
